title: Kouzelná tužka
desc: Co Ondra nakreslí zlatou tužkou, to ožije. Nakreslený pejsek udělá nepořádek — a pak přijde kamarádka.
desc_en: Whatever Oliver draws with the golden pencil comes alive. A drawn puppy makes a mess, and then a friend arrives.
world: a cozy child's bedroom with a big white sheet of paper on the floor, crayons, toy shelves and a sunny window
setting: Útulný dětský pokoj s velkým bílým papírem na zemi, pastelkami, poličkami s hračkami a oknem.
music: magical playful children's music, pizzicato strings, celesta and bassoon, curious and funny, instrumental, 100 bpm

oliver.name: Ondra
oliver.desc: a curious 7-year-old boy with spiky black hair and a big grin, wearing a red and white striped T-shirt and blue overalls
oliver.look: Zvídavý sedmiletý kluk s ježatými černými vlasy a širokým úsměvem, v červenobíle pruhovaném tričku a modrých laclácích.

spot.name: pejsek Flíček
spot.desc: a small fluffy white puppy with one black spot around his eye, floppy ears and a wagging tail, drawn with slightly sketchy crayon outlines
spot.look: Malé chlupaté bílé štěně s černou skvrnou kolem oka, klopenýma ušima a vrtícím ocáskem, s lehce načrtnutými obrysy jako od pastelky.

shots.action: Ondra sedí sám na zemi v uklizeném pokoji s bradou v dlaních, za oknem prší. Vzdychne a bubnuje prsty o podlahu.
shots.keyframe: Oliver sits alone on the floor of his tidy bedroom, bored, chin on his hands, rain on the window
shots.motion: Oliver sighs, taps his fingers on the floor and looks around the room
shots.narration_en: Oliver was bored. It was raining outside.

shots.action: Ondra vytáhne zpod postele zářící zlatou tužku. Zajiskří a Ondra vykulí oči.
shots.keyframe: Oliver pulls a glowing golden pencil from under his bed
shots.motion: Oliver pulls the golden pencil out from under the bed, it sparkles and his eyes grow wide
shots.narration_en: Under his bed he found a golden pencil.

shots.action: Ondra nakreslí na velký papír kruh a vybarví ho načerveno, z kresby stoupají jiskry. Z papíru vyskočí skutečný červený míč a skáče, Ondra překvapeně ucukne.
shots.keyframe: Oliver kneels over a big sheet of paper on the floor and draws a red ball with the golden pencil
motion: Oliver draws a circle on the paper and colors it red, sparkles rise from the drawing
a real red ball pops out of the paper and bounces, Oliver jumps back in surprise
shots.narration: Nakreslil míč… a míč vyskočil z papíru!
shots.narration_en: He drew a ball… and it jumped off the paper!

shots.action: Nakreslený dort zajiskří a promění se ve skutečný dort s třešní. Ondra si olízne rty a směje se.
shots.keyframe: Oliver kneels next to a real cake with a cherry that has appeared on the paper
shots.motion: the drawn cake sparkles and becomes real, Oliver licks his lips and laughs
shots.narration_en: He drew a cake. And it was real!

shots.action: Ondra klečí nad papírem se zlatou tužkou a z papíru se souká pejsek Flíček, napůl kresba, napůl skutečný. Oklepe se, zavrtí ocáskem a olízne Ondrovi nos.
shots.keyframe: Oliver kneels over the paper holding the golden pencil while Spot the puppy climbs out of the paper, half drawing and half real
motion: sparkles swirl around the drawing, the puppy wiggles out of the paper onto the floor
the puppy shakes himself, wags his tail and licks Oliver's nose, Oliver laughs
shots.narration: Pak nakreslil pejska. Flíček ožil a olízl mu nos!
shots.narration_en: Then he drew a puppy. Spot came alive and licked his nose!

shots.action: Flíček se prožene pokojem a hračky padají z poliček. Pak se zastaví a vrtí ocáskem.
shots.keyframe: Spot the puppy runs around the bedroom knocking toys off the shelves
shots.motion: the puppy dashes around the room, toys tumble off the shelf, then he stops and wags his tail
shots.narration_en: Spot ran around and made a big mess.

shots.action: Ondra stojí v pokoji plném rozházených hraček, chytí se za hlavu a pak se rozesměje.
shots.keyframe: Oliver stands in his messy bedroom full of scattered toys, hands on his head
shots.motion: Oliver looks at the mess, puts his hands on his head and then laughs

shots.action: Ondra nakreslí velkou bednu, ta se zhmotní a hračky do ní jedna po druhé vlétnou. Víko se zavře.
shots.keyframe: Oliver draws a big toy box on the paper with the golden pencil, toys fly into the real box
shots.motion: the drawn box becomes real, the toys fly into it one by one and the lid closes
shots.narration_en: He drew a toy box. All tidy!

shots.action: Ondra v uklizeném pokoji tančí radostný hip hop a vlní tělem i rukama.
shots.keyframe: Oliver stands in the middle of his tidy bedroom, grinning
shots.motion: Oliver dances a happy hip hop dance on the spot, waving his body and arms to the beat, same striped T-shirt, same bedroom
shots.narration: Ondra radostí tancoval a Flíček štěkal do rytmu.
shots.narration_en: Oliver danced for joy, and Spot barked along.

shots.action: Ondra opatrně kreslí zlatou tužkou holčičku s culíkem a z papíru stoupají jiskry.
shots.keyframe: Oliver draws a girl with a ponytail on the paper with the golden pencil, smiling
shots.motion: Oliver draws carefully with the golden pencil, sparkles rise from the paper
shots.narration_en: Last of all, he drew a friend.

shots.action: Z papíru vystoupí usměvavá holčička s hnědým culíkem ve žlutých šatech a zamává. Ondra jí zamává zpátky.
shots.keyframe: a smiling girl with a brown ponytail and a yellow dress steps out of the paper and waves at Oliver
shots.motion: the girl steps out of the paper and waves at Oliver, and he waves back
shots.narration: Ahoj, jsem Ema! A už se nenudil.
shots.narration_en: Hi, I'm Emma! And he wasn't bored anymore.

shots.action: Ondra hodí červený míč, Flíček za ním běží a přinese ho zpátky. Ondra se směje.
shots.keyframe: Oliver and Spot the puppy play with a red ball in the bedroom
shots.motion: Oliver throws the red ball, the puppy chases it and brings it back, Oliver laughs
shots.narration: Hráli si spolu až do večera.
